title: Homogeneity of the expectation operator
statement:
Let $n$ be an arity and let $i$ be one of its coordinates. For every scalar $c \in \bbr$ and every Boolean function $f : \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$, applying the expectation operator in direction $i$ to the scaled function $c\,f$ yields $c$ times the expectation operator applied to $f$:
\[
  E_i(c\,f) = c\,E_i f.
\]
hypotheses_covered: arity n and coordinate direction i : Fin n
replaced:
The expectation operator commutes with scalar multiplication:
$E_i(c\cdot f) = c\cdot E_i f$ for $c\in\bbr$.
